question: If $A$ and $B$ are two independent events such that $P(A) = 0.5$ and $P(B) = 0.6$, which of the following represents $P(A \cup B)$?
explanation:
Since A and B are independent:
$P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A)P(B) = 0.5 + 0.6 - 0.5 \times 0.6 = 1.1 - 0.3 = 0.8$

Answer: B) 0.8
